in_marathi.name: Shivvansh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shivvansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Shivvansh is a name derived from the word 'Shiva', which means 'auspicious'. The suffix 'Vansh' means 'lineage' or 'descendants'. Therefore, Shivvansh can be interpreted as 'God's lineage' or 'the lineage of Shiva'.
